findings.title: Подтверждённый отказ HTTP 408 навсегда блокирует создание новых задач
findings.contract: C4.4 reconnect/reload recovery; negative 408 correction path; acceptance 5, 15, 19.
findings.trigger: POST /api/tasks receives exact candidate Boundary response 408 request_timeout before Core admission; subsequent GET /api/requests/{key} returns 404.
findings.actual: 408 is absent from known rejection branch. Persistent pending marker remains. Reconciliation maps the absent request to UNKNOWN; new-task and form stay disabled after successful session recovery, refresh, and fresh page load.
findings.impact: One ordinary request body timeout prevents all subsequent Mini App task creation in this browser storage, despite no admitted task. No in-product recovery exit exists.
findings.recommendation: Handle the exact trusted pre-admission 408 outcome as a refused request and restore the form. Keep generic network UNKNOWN and opaque 404 fail-closed; do not solve this with blind POST replay or blanket 404-as-not-executed.

findings.title: Истёкшее восстановленное уточнение оставляет форму в непригодном режиме
findings.contract: C4.5 stale/expired clarification has clear next action; C4.7 consistent form/focus; acceptance 7, 15, 19.
findings.trigger: Restore clarification after reload (private title was not persisted); submit an answer after clarification expiry; Core returns not_accepted/clarification_invalid.
findings.actual: The token is cleared, but the title input remains hidden, the question and clarification heading remain displayed, and the enabled submit action does not match new-intent validation. Subsequent submit silently returns because normal requests require the hidden empty title.
findings.impact: The visible form cannot submit a revised task. Closing it and pressing New again works but is not the offered recovery path.
findings.recommendation: Reset the composer to a consistent editable new-request mode when clarification closes: visible required title, normal heading/action, cleared obsolete question/token, and appropriate error/focus.
